description: Implement the Scheduled Reports tab with scheduling UI, recipient configuration, format selection, and run history; and the Export Center tab with bulk data export, format options, filter application, and download history
steps: Implement src/components/reports/ScheduledReports.jsx with: (a) A list/table of existing scheduled reports from AppContext (scheduledReports) showing name, report type, frequency, last run, status, recipients count. (b) Create Schedule button that opens a form/modal to configure a new scheduled report: name, report type dropdown, frequency (daily/weekly/monthly), recipient list (add/remove email inputs), format selection (PDF mock, CSV export, On-screen). (c) Run History section showing past executions from the scheduledReports data with timestamps, status (success/failed/pending), and format. (d) Enable/disable toggle per schedule. (e) Delete schedule functionality. (f) Persist changes through AppContext updateScheduledReports.

Implement src/components/reports/ExportCenter.jsx with: (a) Data type selection - cards/buttons for Nurses, Placements, Documents, Communications. (b) Format selection - CSV or JSON radio/button group. (c) Filter panel that shows relevant filters based on selected data type (e.g., for Nurses: cohort filter, stage filter, specialty filter; for Placements: facility filter, stage filter). (d) Export button that generates the file (CSV or JSON) from AppContext data with filters applied and triggers a download. (e) Download History section showing past exports from AppContext (exportHistory) with timestamp, data type, format, file size, and a re-download button. (f) Persist export history through AppContext updateExportHistory.

For the Export Center CSV generation, reuse the CSV generation pattern from the existing ReportBuilder in src/components/analytics/ReportBuilder.jsx (Blob creation, URL.createObjectURL, programmatic click). For JSON export, use JSON.stringify with pretty-printing and the same download pattern.
Style both components consistently with the existing UI patterns. Use the card-based layout with border-gray-200. Tables should match the report preview table style.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled Reports tab displays list of schedules with frequency, recipients, format, status
Users can create new scheduled reports with all configuration options
Run history table shows past report executions
Export Center shows data type selection for Nurses, Placements, Documents, Communications
Format toggle between CSV and JSON works
Download generates actual file (CSV or JSON) from AppContext data
Download history log persists via localStorage
verification: Run npm run build and confirm exit code 0
Run npm run lint and confirm no errors
